deliverable.source_excerpt: #!/usr/bin/env python3 """Fail-closed release gate for product-specific media evidence. This validates declared artifacts; it does not prove scientific claims, customer quality, or that a provider integration works. Paths are resolved under --root. """ from __future__ import annotations import argparse import json import re import struct from pathlib import Path from urllib.parse import urlparse REQUIRED = ( "product_id", "version", "short_description", "passport_url", "qr_target_url", "screenshot_path", "screenshot_kind", "demo_video_path", "demo_status", "usage_guide_path", "qr_scan_test", "photo_asset_status", ) ID_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9._-]{2,63}$") def is_http_url(value: object) -> bool: if not isinstance(value, str): return False parsed = urlparse(value) return parsed.scheme in {"https", "http"} and bool(parsed.netloc) def has_raster_signature(path: Path) -> bool: try: head = path.read_bytes()[:16] except OSError: return False return ( head.startswith(b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n") or head.startswith(b"\xff\\xd8\xff") or (len(head) >= 12 and head[:4] == b"RIFF" and head[8:12] == b"WEBP") ) def has_mp4_signature(path: Path) -> bool: try: head = path.read_bytes()[:32] except OSError: return False # ISO Base Media File Format commonly stores the ftyp box at byte offset 4. return len(head) >= 12 and head[4:8] == b"ftyp" def validate_manifest(manifest: object, root: Path) -
